items.title: Randy Sandke interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 10, 1997
items.q: like Flip Phillips in these interviews that I’ve had with these guys

ctx.x: I know what you’re saying though.

But they’re being encouraged to feel that way I think. And look it’s a phase, nothing lasts forever, the pendulum swings. Maybe because of the quirks of history things have to be this way right now, and we’ll get to another side of it and everything. As I say, just as I see it, my frustration is okay, this is the time I happen to be living in. I look back on this time when Bix and Louis just loved each other and got along fine, when there was so much fraternal — I mean like Flip Phillips in these interviews that…
Well you said it about five times already, that the music was the focus. That the music brought them together I would guess.
